what: The first real-scale GUI campaign this project has run. 5000 inputs against eog through the accessibility oracle, on a quiet Linux host.
host: Ubuntu 22.04 aarch64, 8 vCPU, load ~1, inside the documented hforge-gui image so the environment matches every earlier GUI run.
the_controls_held: The campaign refuses to run unless an unmodified seed opens cleanly and a deliberately corrupt one is refused. Both passed, so the zero is a measurement rather than a broken harness.
acceptance_is_stable_across_three_orders: 29% at 12 inputs, 29% at 400, 29% at 5000. The mutators reach the same proportion past the front door however long they run.
WHAT_THIS_SAYS: eog does not crash or hang on 5000 structure-aware PNG mutations. That is a real negative result and it is the first one this track has been able to state. It is NOT evidence that eog is sound: the campaign is BLIND -- no coverage feedback -- so it cannot tell a productive mutation from a wasted one, and 3574 of 5000 inputs were refused at the front door without exercising the decoder at all.
what_it_costs_to_fix: GUIFUZZ++ is grey-box and found 23 bugs across 11-12 applications. The missing piece here is coverage feedback, which needs eog rebuilt with instrumentation -- and the host is at 97% disk. That is the next constraint, not the next idea.
honest_rating_unchanged: The oracle earns its 7/10: five-way verdicts, controls that fire, a stable acceptance rate across 3 orders of magnitude. The search is still 3/10 and 5000 blind inputs do not change that.
